project: Enchant itself (/home/othman/projects/enchant is a symlink to this repository). Measured in a private `git worktree` of main at /tmp/m1-othman/enchant, never in the user's checkout.
why_a_private_checkout: `$MAIN/bin/bl` from the copy would serve the copy as a project through main's warm VM, which other agents and the integrator share; `realm stop` per cycle would stop their VM, and case 5 (a priv/lib edit) can only be made in an engine checkout. research/substrate-ab/m1/copy.sh links the copy's .bl state to the exact store paths main selected (same client binary, same SDK, same fingerprint), so `COPY/bin/bl` is main's client on main's SDK in its own VM and nothing was prepared (same VM pid throughout every cycle, current-sdk unchanged).
how: research/substrate-ab/m1/m1.py under `work run --memory 4G`: 5 cycles, each `realm stop` -> first command -> 3x each warm command -> 4 body edits -> 3 macro-provider edits -> 3 priv/lib edits -> revert; then 5 `--cold` pairs. Wall = save (inside the timed span) to command exit. Every edit verified by output (the probe prints the edited message and both macro dependents' expansion). Attribution: one extra cycle with a call tracer (m1_trace.erl, exception_trace on Loader/do_load, AOT/ensure_loaded_local, Compiler/eval_string, Daemon/handle-in-vm, Cli/run-argv, Realm/open) and two with a 1 ms stack sampler (m1_sampler.erl); those runs are not in the timings.

commands.run-probe: bl run m1_probe.bl (requires scene-demo.frame-plan and scene-demo.film)

fixture: Enchant has no project macro provider with project dependents (only examples/macros.bl, hygiene.bl, standalone). The copy adds scene_demo/m1_guard.bl (two macros) expanded by scene-demo.frame-plan and scene-demo.film. Library edit: priv/lib/scene/core.bl `fail`, called by frame-plan.

3_macro_provider_edit.dependents_recompiled: all loaded project namespaces: the provider plus both dependents (3 of 3) for run-probe; provider plus frame-plan (2 of 2) for test. Both dependents showed the new expansion every time (15/15).

5_priv_lib_edit_U15.note: edit seen every time (15/15), same VM, no SDK preparation

where_the_time_goes.client: Unchanged: 0.5-0.6 ms before exec (platform 0.32, service 0.19). After a project edit: 10-17 ms, the generation service answering after inotify. After a priv/lib edit: the service declines at its 150 ms read timeout and the client inventories locally, 118-404 ms (median client 136-483 ms). One body edit (cycle 4) took 16.3 s: service timed out at 157 ms, then the local inventory took 15.46 s.
where_the_time_goes.vm_handler: handle-in-vm minus run-argv is ~1 ms on an unchanged request. After a project edit it adds realm/open 47-67 ms (retire and reopen). After a priv/lib edit it is ~1.1 s (handle-in-vm 1,028-1,376 ms vs run-argv 216-221 ms): the U15 overlay compiling core.bl and re-deriving the SDK runtime inventory (sampler: AOT/sdk_runtime_inventory_uncached!, Env/retain_sdk_runtime!, Env/install_dev_sdk_unit!).
where_the_time_goes.compile: Project namespaces are never restored: AOT/ensure_loaded_local returns :no_module for every project namespace on every new realm, so each edit recompiles the whole loaded project closure: frame-plan 80-133 ms (18 lines), film 85-127 ms (33 lines), m1-guard 10-21 ms. The test file itself is recompiled on every `bl test` (6-12 ms) even unchanged. `bl test` and `bl run` load project code separately, so the first `run` after a `test` recompiles too (the bimodal 'next command' rows: ~11 ms vs ~200-320 ms).
where_the_time_goes.run: run-argv on an unchanged warm test is 145-320 ms traced; the sampler puts ~40% of it in loading (Loader/find_file, note_absent, File.regular?/dir? probes, PackageAuthority/sdk_checked_declaration_table) and ~35% in compiling (test file). hello.bl re-evaluates its top-level defns every run (Lower/eval-anf-record, module purge).
where_the_time_goes.first_check: The first `bl check` in a VM compiles bl.check and ~27 more SDK namespaces from source (AOT/compile_sdk_source!, bl.check alone 897 ms): 1.3-2.1 s, later 115-135 ms.
where_the_time_goes.cold: First command after `realm stop` through the warm path: 5.2-6.5 s, 1.7 s more than `bl --cold test` of the same file (3.3-5.4 s).

previous: 2026-11-20 on the installed drop f5ee4ce9, a two-namespace scratch project: body edit 170-269 ms, macro edit 167-169 ms, unchanged 110-219 ms (journal 06). Not comparable: different project size and drop.
top_costs: C-a: every project edit recompiles the whole loaded project closure, not the edited namespace (no project unit cache): 450-500 ms per edit for 3 small files.
C-b: the first command in a fresh checkout VM costs 5.8 s, 1.7 s over --cold.
C-c: a priv/lib edit costs 1.1-1.5 s, ~1 s of it in the overlay's SDK inventory re-derivation, plus a 150 ms generation-service timeout and a local inventory (once 15.5 s after a project edit).
